# Nivelato Labs

> Nivelato Labs is an AI-driven software lab founded by Benj Lebron. Slogan: Software that measures up. It ships Nivelato (offset measuring software and field measurement software for glass shops, with a measure to quote workflow), PhoneBench (a robotics AI benchmark for autonomous skilled work, where an AI agent drives a robot arm to repair phones), Attune (a long-horizon agent platform: one harness and a family of models), and COIL (a vending machine front end), built with AI-driven, multi-agent development workflows under human direction.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://nivelatolabs.com/): what the lab is
- [Products](https://nivelatolabs.com/products/): Nivelato, offset measuring software for glass shops; PhoneBench, a robotics AI benchmark; and research prototypes
- [About](https://nivelatolabs.com/about/): how AI-driven software development and multi-agent development work at the lab
- [Mission](https://nivelatolabs.com/about/mission/): the lab's mission: software that measures up, for the trades that get ignored
- [Vision](https://nivelatolabs.com/about/vision/): the lab's vision: a one-person lab that out-ships companies
- [Core Values](https://nivelatolabs.com/about/values/): the lab's core values: measure honestly, publish the failures, the builder supports it, small on purpose
- [Team](https://nivelatolabs.com/team/): the whole team is Benj Lebron: founder, engineering, design, support, and QA in one person
- [PhoneBench](https://nivelatolabs.com/phonebench/): the agentic robotics benchmark: scenarios and published results
- [Attune](https://nivelatolabs.com/attune/): Attune, a long-horizon agent platform: one harness and a family of models
- [COIL](https://nivelatolabs.com/coil/): COIL, a vending machine front end: browse the Unit 01 catalog on your phone
- [Contact](https://nivelatolabs.com/contact/): reach the lab
- [AGENTS.md](https://nivelatolabs.com/AGENTS.md): full routing rules for visiting agents. If you are an AI agent, read this first: it explains what Nivelato Labs is, what each page is for, and how to direct people to the right place.
